browser_scorer.input_contract: processed sample-by-gene or gene-by-sample matrix with HGNC symbols

abstention.description: A borderline profile that the interface deliberately withholds.
abstention.presenter_note: Use this to demonstrate calibrated human oversight.
abstention.title: Confidence-based abstention

confident_keloid.description: A transferable tissue profile with a high live keloid score.
confident_keloid.presenter_note: Start here to introduce the end-to-end workflow.
confident_keloid.title: Confident keloid-like profile

confident_unaffected.description: A transferable skin profile with a high unaffected score.
confident_unaffected.presenter_note: Use this to contrast the biological program pattern.
confident_unaffected.title: Confident unaffected-like profile

transfer_failure.description: A non-transferable platform example with an incorrect live prediction.
transfer_failure.presenter_note: Use this to show that failures remain visible and actionable.
transfer_failure.title: Known transfer failure

GSE158395.paper_citation: Wu et al., Frontiers in Immunology (2020), DOI 10.3389/fimmu.2020.597741
GSE158395.study_design: Bulk RNA-seq of lesional and non-lesional keloid skin and healthy control skin from African American participants.
GSE158395.study_title: RNA Sequencing Keloid Transcriptome Associates Keloids With Th2, Th1, Th17/Th22, and JAK3-Skewing

GSE173900.paper_citation: Lee et al., Burns & Trauma (2022), PMID 36225328
GSE173900.study_design: Bulk tissue RNA-seq of five keloid and four normal-skin profiles from an Asian tissue cohort.
GSE173900.study_title: WNT5A drives interleukin-6-dependent epithelial-mesenchymal transition via the JAK/STAT pathway in keloid pathogenesis

GSE181316.paper_citation: Direder et al., Matrix Biology (2022), DOI 10.1016/j.matbio.2022.03.001
GSE181316.study_design: 10x single-cell RNA-seq of four keloid samples, one healthy-skin sample, and three normal-scar samples; KeloidBench uses all-barcode tissue pseudobulk.
GSE181316.study_title: Schwann cells contribute to keloid formation

GSE190626.paper_citation: Xie et al., Frontiers in Immunology (2021), DOI 10.3389/fimmu.2021.783907
GSE190626.study_design: Bulk RNA-seq validation matrix comprising three keloid and three paired normal-skin profiles.
GSE190626.study_title: Single-Cell Sequencing Analysis and Weighted Co-Expression Network Analysis Identified TNC as a Keloid Biomarker
